notes: ZyPer4K-XS is a product family sold as separate encoder and decoder units, each in copper (RJ45) or fiber variants: Z4KENCC3XS (copper encoder), Z4KENCF3XS (fiber encoder), Z4KDECC3XS (copper decoder, modeled here), Z4KDECF3XS (fiber decoder). This entry models the copper Decoder. Encoder differs only in I/O direction: HDMI 2.0 IN (Media Input) instead of OUT, analog audio port is input-or-output (3.5mm mic/line style unbalanced stereo jack) instead of output-only, and USB connector is Mini-B (device) instead of USB-A (host) on the decoder — USB is used for HID pass-through between paired XS/XR units, not general host/peripheral use. Fiber variants replace the "Media Transport" copper RJ45 (10Gb PoE, Cat6a 100m) with an SFP+ fiber port (multimode 300m / single-mode 10km); exact SFP connector (LC) inferred from standard ZeeVee fiber module practice, not explicitly itemized in the datasheet. The "Utility" RJ45 is a 10/100/1Gb management port for ZMP control, separate from the 10Gb media-transport Ethernet port. Power input is a 12V DC locking barrel connector fed by an included external AC power supply (brick), so the device-side connector is a DC barrel jack, not the AC mains inlet itself. Ethernet media-transport port is rated 10Gb — no exact grade tier (e.g. 10g vs multi-gig) beyond "10Gb" is stated, so eth-10g was used. HDMI ports are HDMI 2.0 per datasheet. Decoder power draw ~8W; encoder ~15W (per family datasheet), same chassis/connector layout.
